svg.text: Wigner-6j recoupling moves the tensor products from the edges to the nodes

text.tspan: Colour marks what a factor depends on:

svg.text: messages from all neighbours j of i
solid spherical harmonics of order ℓ
order 1 is linear, so an edge factor splits into two node factors
higher orders are tensor powers of the order-1 factor
the solid harmonic is evaluated on every edge
no edge factor is left, but i and j are still multiplied inside the neighbour sum
every neighbour sum depends on j alone: aggregate once per node, then multiply by the centre factor
linear in atoms, not in neighbours
The Wigner-6j symbol re-associates a double tensor product, so the neighbour-only pair is contracted first
inner product mixes i and j
inner product depends on j only
summed over j once per node, before the last product
one cell per m, rows for each ℓ
